title: New Mac app animates desktop icons with live AI usage data
excerpt: IconSwapper is a new Mac application that brings desktop icons to life using real-time data, playful customizations, and animations.
body_html:
A new application called IconSwapper has been released for Mac users, offering a way to display real-time data and live AI usage directly on desktop app icons.

The utility aims to make the macOS desktop more interactive by introducing animations, playful customizations, and live updates to standard application icons.
